explanation: 8 meters stopped reporting at 2016-06-23 10:00:00. These customers most likely still have power; only their data stopped. The alternative considered was OUTAGE. Decided at 2016-06-23 10:30:00, 2 intervals after the meters went silent, by method bayes.
